ci_support_linux_64_.yaml:
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
python_min:
- '3.11'

about.description:
Thin, dependency-light adapter that wraps an LLM guardrail verdict (Llama Guard, NeMo Guardrails,
guardrails-ai or any callable) and emits a signed, hash-chained DSSE decision receipt aligned with the
SZL governed-receipt specification. Falls back to an explicitly UNSIGNED receipt rather than fabricating
a signature.
about.summary: Wraps any LLM guardrail verdict and emits a signed, hash-chained DSSE decision receipt.

name: szl-guardrail-receipt
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "0.1.2"

package:
  name: szl-guardrail-receipt
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/s/szl-guardrail-receipt/szl_guardrail_receipt-0.1.2.tar.gz
  sha256: d2ce242d0b8c1a2ad2b618ad545dd8d0d444479279b25bb028db89670b06785b

build:
  noarch: python
  number: 0
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - hatchling
    - pip
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - szl_guardrail_receipt
      python_version:
        - ${{ python_min }}.*
        - "*"
      pip_check: true

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/szl-holdings/szl-guardrail-receipt
  repository: https://github.com/szl-holdings/szl-guardrail-receipt
  documentation: https://github.com/szl-holdings/szl-guardrail-receipt#readme
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: Wraps any LLM guardrail verdict and emits a signed, hash-chained DSSE decision receipt.
  description: |
    Thin, dependency-light adapter that wraps an LLM guardrail verdict (Llama Guard, NeMo Guardrails,
    guardrails-ai or any callable) and emits a signed, hash-chained DSSE decision receipt aligned with the
    SZL governed-receipt specification. Falls back to an explicitly UNSIGNED receipt rather than fabricating
    a signature.

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - stephenlutar2-hash
